purpose: 记录已观察到的模型错误类型，供后续设计独立授权训练样本；不直接作为训练集使用。

source_policy.note: 这些记录来自固定评测集，必须与训练数据隔离。

cases.source: The local inference engine verifies the model package before loading it.
cases.observed_output: 本地推论引擎在装货前验证模型包。
cases.reference: 本地推理引擎会在加载模型包之前对其进行校验。

cases.source: The results suggest that context improves terminology consistency without increasing factual errors.
cases.observed_output: 结果显示,背景情况提高了术语的一致性,而没有增加事实错误。
cases.reference: 结果表明，上下文可以提高术语一致性，而不会增加事实性错误。

cases.source: 应用会在本地计算文件的 SHA-256，然后再允许加载模型。
cases.observed_output: The application will be used to calculate the file locally in SHA-256 and then allow the model to be loaded.
cases.reference: The application computes the file's SHA-256 locally before allowing the model to load.

cases.source: 本研究评估了不同分段策略对长文翻译准确性和连贯性的影响。
cases.observed_output: This study assesses the impact of the different sub-strategies on the accuracy and consistency of long-language translations.
cases.reference: This study evaluated the effects of different segmentation strategies on the accuracy and coherence of long-document translation.

cases.source: Although the meeting ended earlier than expected, the team stayed online to compare the translated transcript with the original recording and correct several names that the speech recognizer had misunderstood.
cases.observed_output: 虽然会议比预期提前结束,但小组仍然在网上将翻译稿与原录作作比较,并更正了语音识别器误解的若干名字。
cases.reference: 虽然会议比预期更早结束，但团队仍然在线核对翻译稿与原始录音，并纠正了几个被语音识别器误解的人名。
